bear_assumptions: Apply 22x USD 13 normalized forward diluted EPS as export controls, customer concentration and a fab-spending slowdown reduce utilization, working capital absorbs cash and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: Apply 28x USD 16 normalized forward diluted EPS as fiscal-Q4 guidance broadly converts, leading-edge logic, DRAM, advanced packaging and AGS growth persist, and margins normalize below peak expectations.
bull_assumptions: Apply 34x USD 19 normalized forward diluted EPS as AI-related materials intensity, six new DRAM and packaging systems, service growth and product leadership sustain above-cycle earnings, share gains and margins.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence normalized earnings make expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade further if leading-edge or DRAM demand weakens, AGS growth stalls, gross margin reverses, free-cash-flow conversion deteriorates, export restrictions intensify or concentration causes material volatility.
